scope: Combined donor and controller isolated unit tests; no workflow execution or clean delivery
source_binding: Every copied input matches base Git blob and mode before overlay; final file-set, byte hashes and modes guarded before/after execution
admission: Only after existing validation is terminal, reviewed scripts and plan committed, exact source manifest prepared and preserved; no parallel Cargo on this target
stop_rule: Run phases sequentially; stop first failing phase and retain immutable evidence. No automatic retry.
remaining_requirements: Executed native CLI acceptance including startup/restore and all controls
